Name: Infinite Inventory
Author: exarobibliologist
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]There are lots of backpack upgrades for Stardew Valley. I've tried many of them, but dropped them for one reason or other. This is no way suggests they are bad; many are great mods! I just wanted something a bit more tailored for my style of gameplay.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Presenting, Infinite Inventory! A no-fuss solution for storing everything on your back![/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Of course, it's not infinite in the strictest definition of the word because Harmony does require a number to be set for amount of slots available in a pack. But it is functionally infinite, because whenever you get close to that number, it automatically increases the size of your backpack by another 12 so you never run out of space.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]UPDATE: As requested by @mingliu512 the Infinite Inventory mod also dynamically decreases in size too. Now, as you store, sell, or offload items out of your inventory, the inventory will shrink back down to a maximum of 32 slots.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]This may occasionally result in an unusual shuffling of the inventory—if a lot of random spaces in between items open, the mod will dynamically shrink the inventory by moving items from the end of your inventory into those spaces to open up a large set of empty slots that can be shrunk, or (if spaces open up at the beginning of the inventory) moving all the inventory rows up by one row.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]There are no settings in this mod. It does the expansion automatically, so you'll never need to enter a command or fiddle with things to get your backpack working.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]It's practically infinite...[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Use Vortex to install[/color]
Or, decompress the zip file to Stardew Valley\Mods[/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Start a new game[/b] (not sure how this will work on existing games that used other backpack mods originally)...[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Enjoy infinite space in your backpack.
(NOTE: You will never need to buy backpack upgrades from Pierre. Your backpack should increase automatically and continuously as you get more stuff)[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Tweaks GameMenu to give a practically infinite backpack...[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Also Works With...[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32032]Better Game Menu[/url][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]May Conflict With...[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Any mod that modifies GameMenu, except the mods listed above.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you need another mod added to the "Works With" list, let me know in the comments, and I'll try to work something out.[/color][/size]
